test_policy.notes: Camden is test-optional (Rutgers states test-optional policies 'through 2027'); applicants who do not submit scores get full consideration. Exception: applicants to the BS/DO program must submit at least one ACT or SAT score.

requirements.supplemental_essays: A short original essay is required (Rutgers Application: 3,800 characters; Common App: 250-650 words).
requirements.notes: Apply with the Rutgers Application or the Common App; the $70 non-refundable fee is the same on both. Letters of recommendation are 'not used' for admission; activities are recommended. Current high school students report coursework through the STARS record. Per the Camden deadlines page, F-1 first-year fall 2027 applicants can enroll full-time in the College of Arts & Sciences, School of Business-Camden or School of Nursing-Camden. Financial documents (ISFS) are due after the offer is accepted, for the I-20.

deadlines.label: Early Action (non-binding), first-year fall 2027
deadlines.notes: Online decision January 31, 2027; candidate reply May 1, 2027. The page says 'These are not deadlines. You may apply after due dates have passed'; later applications are reviewed in the order received. Required credentials are due two weeks after the application due date. The page lists no separate international date.

deadlines.label: Regular Decision, first-year fall 2027
deadlines.notes: Online decision February 28, 2027; candidate reply May 1, 2027. Not a hard deadline (see Early Action note). The page lists no separate international date.

deadlines.label: Candidate reply date
deadlines.notes: Printed as the reply date for both plans; the earlier Rutgers page text says it is not a hard deadline and enrollment stays open while space remains.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Required if secondary school was outside the U.S. in a country where English is not the primary language; scores must be under two years old. Waivers for English-medium schooling are decided case by case (email RUinternational@admissions.rutgers.edu after the application is complete). A B or better in a college-level English Composition course at an accredited U.S. college also exempts; ESL courses, courses taken outside the U.S. and correspondence/online courses do not. The page's table also lists SAT EBRW 550, ACT English 21 and Michigan English Test 56 as accepted proof.

Camden minimum; New Brunswick and Newark are 6.5.
Cambridge Assessment test at level B2 (no numeric score printed).

aid.notes: Rutgers-Camden's International Chancellor's Scholarship goes to nonsponsored F-1 first-year and transfer students with no separate application. The two Camden pages disagree on size: the scholarships page says 'up to $17,000 per year', while the dedicated scholarship page lists weighted-GPA tiers for first-years (2.8-3.19: $16,000; 3.2-3.69: $18,000; 3.7-4.0: $21,000 per year), renewable with a 2.5 GPA; confirm the current amount with the office. The scholarships page also lists a #YouAreWelcomeHere Scholarship covering a minimum of 50% of tuition for first-year international students. No need-based aid for international students is described.

act.note: ACT score must include the writing component.
